payload.author: experimental_development
payload.hypothesis: Widening the compact_transformer hidden dimension from 128 to 256 (while maintaining depth=4, 49-token conv tokenizer, 4 heads) will improve validation accuracy by providing greater representational capacity to distinguish subtle texture and morphological differences between visually confusable histopathology classes (smooth muscle vs stroma, normal mucosa vs adenocarcinoma, background vs debris). The 49-token sequence remains short enough to avoid overfitting on ~90k samples, and the wider attention/MLP layers can encode richer inter-cellular relationship patterns. Reducing label smoothing from 0.1 to 0.05 and lowering LR to 1.5e-4 should allow sharper decision boundaries in the final epochs without destabilizing training.
